public_body: Medford Ad Hoc Sub Committee To The Malden Hospital Site Development Committee
overall: The AG found the three-member subcommittee violated the Open Meeting Law by deliberating by group email, since a quorum replied on a survey and mission statement, and ordered compliance and release of the email chain.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the three-member subcommittee deliberated outside a public meeting through group emails on a community survey and mission statement.
allegations.key_passage: Because this deliberation took place outside of a noticed meeting, we find that the Subcommittee violated the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Allegations raised only in the request for further review, not in the original complaint, were not examined.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to review any allegations made in the request for further review.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
Release to the public, within 30 days of receipt of the determination, the December 21-28, 2018 email chain.
